title: Heed the Dungeonless
description: Heed the Dungeonless — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and bring him the scalp of the Snow Monster. Don't forget to open some presents while you're there!

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and bring him the scalp of the Snow Monster. Don't forget to open some presents while you're there!

Offer:

Can you spare some room in your quest log for a dungeonless snowman? I wasn't always dungeonless, you know. Why does stuff always happen to me when there are plenty of idiots around here that actually deserve something crappy to happen to them? I know the answer to this will probably be no, but do you think you could help out a poor dungeonless snowman?

Not long ago I had my own quaint little dungeon called the Sanctuary of the Snowmen, which myself and other pathetic snowmen called home. There were no problems; no sunlight, nice AC, no yellow snow, and none of those beasts your kind calls kids. It was... paradise. That is until the snow monsters came. I have no clue how they found out where we were, you probably told them, and now they have taken over the place!

If you can get in there and take the snow monster leader down I can move back in and get off the mean streets of Townston. The snow monsters came right as we were getting ready to do our Secret Santa party so there are some presents laying around. If you manage to kill the Snow Monster you can help yourself to those presents. When you have finished the quest return to me, Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

You did it? Wow, I thought you were going to be all nice to my face then abandon the quest as soon as you left. I don't know what to say... I mean, no one has ever actually HELPED me. Th..than...thannnk...thank you. Ow! Ok, I think I just sprained something. I guess you never realize how hard something is to say until you actually say it for the first time.

Objectives:

  • Enter the Sanctuary of the Snowmen
  • Snow Monster's Scalp ×1
  • Open ''Your'' Presents

Client level range: 5–?
